options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold docume.json and a wiki skeleton in the current directory.

options.name: --space
options.description: Confluence space key to write into docume.json.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Confluence wiki base URL to write into docume.json.

options.name: --adopt
options.description: Build _meta/state.json from the wiki this repo already has (one entry per page, pageIds seeded from frontmatter) instead of writing an empty one. [default: False]

options.name: --legacy-map
options.description: Path to a JSON '<page path>': '<page id>' map from whatever published the wiki before, to seed pageIds from. Requires --adopt.

options.name: --agent
options.description: Which coding agent the model-running workflows are written for: claude or copilot. Recorded in docume.json; omitted, a recorded value wins and a fresh repo gets claude.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert every wiki page and report failures and degradations. Read-only: nothing is published.

options.name: --accept
options.description: Diagnostic code to treat as an accepted loss: still reported, but counted as a note instead of a warning. Repeatable.

options.name: --render-mermaid
options.description: Also render every mermaid diagram through Node and report the ones that fail. Off by default: it starts a process per diagram and needs beautiful-mermaid installed. Without it, diagrams are counted but never checked. [default: False]

options.name: --renderer
options.description: Path to render-mermaid.mjs for --render-mermaid. Defaults to where `docume init` scaffolds it and docume.json -> mermaid.renderer names it. [default: tools/render-mermaid.mjs]

arguments.name: WIKI_ROOT
arguments.description: Wiki root directory to convert (the folder holding the markdown pages).

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Convert the wiki and publish it to Confluence. --dry-run plans the run and writes nothing.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to docume.json. Its directory is the repo root wiki.root resolves against. [default: docume.json]

options.name: --state
options.description: Path to state.json. Defaults to <wiki.root>/_meta/state.json; a missing file plans a first publish (every page created).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Convert, decide and print the plan without writing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Republish every page even when nothing changed, re-uploading its attachments. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-protected-space
options.description: Write into a space listed in confluence.protectedSpaces. One run only; there is no config value that grants this. [default: False]

options.name: --tree
options.description: Also print the page tree the run would build (parents resolved from the directory index pages). [default: False]

options.name: --changed-since
options.description: Write only the pages touched since <sha> — `git diff --name-only` over the wiki root, including the pages whose images changed. The whole tree is still loaded, converted and checked for orphans.

options.name: --page
options.description: Write only these pages (wiki-root-relative markdown paths). Repeatable; a path that is not in the tree is an error. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --prune
options.description: After publishing, delete the orphan pages (state entries whose markdown file is gone) from Confluence. Asks first, needs a terminal, refuses to run in CI. [default: False]

options.name: --no-reorder
options.description: Skip the post-pass that puts each parent's children in source-tree order. Leaves the order in Confluence exactly as it is, for a team that arranges it by hand. [default: False]

options.name: --block-on-open-comments
options.description: Leave a page as it is, and exit non-zero, when it has unresolved inline comments a body rewrite could strand. Default is to publish and warn. Has no effect on --dry-run: the check reads Confluence, which a dry run does not. [default: False]

options.name: --no-comment-check
options.description: Skip the read that looks for unresolved inline comments before rewriting a page (one extra read per page whose body changes; none for creates, skips or moves). [default: False]

options.name: --notify-reviewers
options.description: Post a footer comment asking for a re-review on every page whose `approved` label this run removes. One comment per revoked approval, so it notifies everyone watching those pages; without it the dashboard and `docume status` say the same thing quietly. [default: False]

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Read the approved/stale labels and the page comments out of Confluence and reconcile them into state.json and the feedback inbox. Writes nothing to Confluence unless --reply is passed; committing the result is the caller's job.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to docume.json. Its directory is the repo root wiki.root resolves against. [default: docume.json]

options.name: --state
options.description: Path to state.json. Defaults to <wiki.root>/_meta/state.json.

options.name: --labels
options.description: Reconcile the approved/stale labels into state. Passing no half runs the two read halves. [default: False]

options.name: --comments
options.description: Ingest page comments into the feedback inbox. Passing no half runs the two read halves. [default: False]

options.name: --reply
options.description: Post a reply under every triaged inbox item and resolve the inline comments it answers. Writes to Confluence, so it never runs unless asked for. [default: False]

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Where to write inbox items. Defaults to <wiki.root>/_meta/feedback/inbox.

options.name: --rebuild-state
options.description: Rebuild state.json's page map from the managed marker every DocuMe-written page carries. Runs alone, because it rebuilds the map the other halves reconcile onto; composes only with --dry-run. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change in state.json and the inbox and what would be posted to Confluence, and write none of it. [default: False]

commands.name: drift
commands.description: Report which wiki pages derive from code changed between two revisions. Reads only, unless --mark.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to docume.json. Its directory is the repo root wiki.root and every 'sources' glob resolve against. [default: docume.json]

options.name: --state
options.description: Path to state.json. Defaults to <wiki.root>/_meta/state.json; read for its baselineSha, and written only by --mark.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Revision to diff from. Defaults to state.baselineSha — the commit the wiki content was last generated against.

options.name: --head
options.description: Revision to diff to. Defaults to HEAD. [default: HEAD]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output shape: table | json | github-comment. 'github-comment' is a markdown block for a PR comment; 'json' prints nothing else. [default: table]

options.name: --fail-on-drift
options.description: Exit 1 when any page is affected. Without it the command is advisory and always exits 0. [default: False]

options.name: --mark
options.description: Add the stale label to every affected page in Confluence, set stale: true in state, and refresh the dashboard. Labels only — never a page-body edit (§6.4). [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: With --mark: report what would be labelled and write nothing. Needs no credentials — the plan is state plus the diff. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-protected-space
options.description: With --mark: label pages even though confluence.spaceKey is listed in confluence.protectedSpaces. One run only; the list stays as it is. [default: False]

commands.name: dashboard
commands.description: Regenerate the Documentation Status page in Confluence from state plus the live labels. The only M3 command that writes to Confluence.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to docume.json. Its directory is the repo root wiki.root resolves against. [default: docume.json]

options.name: --state
options.description: Path to state.json. Defaults to <wiki.root>/_meta/state.json. Read only — the labels are reconciled in memory, and `docume sync --labels` is what writes them.

options.name: --title
options.description: Title of the dashboard page. Defaults to dashboard.title in docume.json.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the storage format the run would publish and write nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-protected-space
options.description: Publish even though confluence.spaceKey is listed in confluence.protectedSpaces. One run only; the list stays as it is. [default: False]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report what is published, what drifted, and whether this repo is set up to publish. Writes nothing.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to docume.json. Its directory is the repo root wiki.root resolves against. [default: docume.json]

options.name: --state
options.description: Path to state.json. Defaults to <wiki.root>/_meta/state.json; a missing file means nothing has been published, so every page reads as unpublished.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the report as JSON and nothing else, for a PR body or a CI step. [default: False]

options.name: --offline
options.description: Skip the one Confluence request (the token and space probe). Everything else in this report is computed locally anyway. [default: False]

options.name: --fail-on-drift
options.description: Exit non-zero when the published wiki differs from the repo — unpublished, changed, moved pages, or orphans in state. Without it the command is advisory and always exits 0. [default: False]
